item.title: Three Things From Courtside: Two Nays and a Yay in Florida's Rocky Start Against Baylor
item.excerpt: Chris Spears on Florida's 82-76 overtime exhibition loss to Baylor in Jacksonville: a cold night from three, a bench gap and a late show of fight.

props.name: description
props.content: Chris Spears on Florida's 82-76 overtime exhibition loss to Baylor in Jacksonville: 4-of-29 from three, a 33-3 bench gap and a late show of fight.
